ir.name: pairwise_logistic_margin_delta_rank_scaled_repaired
ir.intuition: The original candidate failed because the loss was insensitive to changes in delta_rank, likely due to a fixed margin that did not scale with delta_rank magnitude. To fix this, replaced the fixed margin with a scaled margin proportional to the absolute value of delta_rank, preserving sign direction using safe division. This makes the margin dynamic and sensitive to the objective signal delta_rank, ensuring the loss varies with ranking differences.
ir.pseudocode:
eps = 1e-8
margin_base = float(extra.get("margin", 0.1))
delta = batch["delta_rank"]
abs_delta = abs(delta)
sign_delta = delta / (abs_delta + eps)
scaled_margin = margin_base * abs_delta * sign_delta
diff = log_prob_w - log_prob_l
adjusted_diff = diff - scaled_margin
preference = log_sigmoid(weight * adjusted_diff)
loss = -preference
return mean(loss)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    eps = 1e-8
    margin_base = float(extra.get("margin", 0.1))
    log_prob_w = batch["log_prob_w"]
    log_prob_l = batch["log_prob_l"]
    weight = batch["weight"]
    delta_rank = batch["delta_rank"]
    abs_delta = ops.abs(delta_rank)
    sign_delta = ops.div(delta_rank, ops.add(abs_delta, eps))
    scaled_margin = ops.mul(margin_base, ops.mul(abs_delta, sign_delta))
    diff = ops.sub(log_prob_w, log_prob_l)
    adjusted_diff = ops.sub(diff, scaled_margin)
    preference = ops.logsigmoid(ops.mul(weight, adjusted_diff))
    loss = ops.mul(preference, -1.0)
    return ops.mean(loss)
